system.description:
Damage of 10 or less never breaks your concentration, and being grappled, shoved or knocked Prone never breaks a spell you are casting or concentrating on.

Available to: Wizards, Clerics, Druids, Illusionists, Paladins, Spellblades, Bards, Sorcerers, Warlocks, Witches, Necromancers, and Artificers.
